darya.main:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production animation source atlas for a mobile 2D runner and side-scrolling world.
Make ONE square transparent sprite sheet of EXACTLY 8 columns by 8 rows, 64 isolated full-body sprites. Equal square cells, generously separated by empty transparent gutters. Absolutely no labels, letters, numbers, grid lines, shadows, floor, scenery, particles or checkerboard. Every sprite belongs wholly inside its cell. Detailed clean chibi game art with crisp contours and lovely expressive faces, matching the second image's established game style. Keep the same identity, clothes, body proportions and scale through every pose. Large head and short body, full shoes visible. All movement poses face RIGHT and sit at the SAME foot baseline within the cell; jump is a body pose only, actual jump height is applied by the game. Crouching/slide sprites must be HALF the standing height while head, face and limbs keep their natural sizes.
Rows in this EXACT order:
ROW 1: eight turn views: front, front-left, left, back-left, back, back-right, right, front-right.
ROW 2: 8 consecutive idle breathing/blinking frames facing right.
ROW 3: 8 consecutive walking frames facing right, complete seamless loop, alternating planted feet.
ROW 4: 8 consecutive FAST RUN frames facing right, complete seamless cycle with clearly different alternating leg and arm positions.
ROW 5: 8 sequential jump poses facing right: crouch preparation, upward impulse, tuck legs, apex, unfold, descent, foot extension, landing anticipation. Keep baseline fixed.
ROW 6: 8 SLIDING frames facing right: a very low athletic knee slide, one knee down, other leg extended forward, torso low and slightly back, head still recognizable, no standing running poses. Entire top of body including hair below half standing height. Low loop with subtle hair flutter.
ROW 7: 8 landing/recovery poses facing right, from low knee bend to upright.
ROW 8: 8 cheerful small waving/celebration poses facing right, seamless loop.
Use a true alpha-transparent background. This must be an accurately spaced 8x8 spritesheet suitable for automatic extraction.
Subject specifics: DARYA + PISHI: female chibi character with flowing layered chocolate-brown shoulder-length wavy hair, fair warm skin, big brown eyes, friendly face, black/dark navy oversized tee, baggy charcoal pants, black-and-white sneakers. Her small gray-brown-and-white kitten Pishi with green eyes and white chest accompanies her in EVERY single frame, positioned immediately behind her feet (to her LEFT as she faces right), clearly separated from her shoes. Walking/running kitten also walks/runs; jumping kitten tucks legs; SLIDE kitten crouches into a similarly low slide alongside her, never on top of her head. Keep recognisable likeness to first reference and existing game's style in second reference.
darya.runSupplement:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final production sprite animation source.
Create exactly TWO rows of EIGHT sequential full-body frames (16 sprites total) on a wide rectangular TRANSPARENT canvas. Equal cells and large empty gutters, no sprite clipping at borders. Preserve exact character style and identity of the reference image. No other rows, no labels, no checkerboard, no floor, shadows, motion lines or text.
TOP ROW = eight distinct FAST RUNNING cycle poses facing RIGHT, clearly alternating legs and arms, hair fluttering, tight continuous loop. Body scale consistent in all cells.
BOTTOM ROW = eight distinct VERY LOW SLIDING cycle poses facing RIGHT: an athletic BASEBALL SLIDE UNDER A LOW BARRIER, torso almost HORIZONTAL, leaned back near the ground, one leg straight FORWARD and the other leg tucked, one hand near ground. Head and hair top must be visibly BELOW HIP HEIGHT of the standing runner above: total visible slide height no more than 55% of the visible standing height. Hair, head and body retain original natural proportions; achieve low height by lying/leaning, not shrinking the person. No sitting upright, no normal standing or running pose in this row. Subtle flutter cycle only; the entire row stays LOW. Every sprite retains same scale; feet aligned near cell bottom. Empty transparent gutters between ALL cells.
Subject: Darya, exact same face and brown hair, black/navy tee and charcoal baggy pants. Include Pishi the tiny gray-white kitten just behind the legs in EVERY frame, also running then sliding low. Cat must never overlap face or shoes.
darya.isolatedSlides:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation asset.
Make a square TRANSPARENT sheet containing EXACTLY 8 SLIDE sprites in FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS. This must NOT use the reference's eight-column layout. Four spacious columns, two rows, ALL fully isolated sprites. Each square cell has very generous transparent margins: the entire silhouette occupies AT MOST 65% OF CELL WIDTH and 45% OF CELL HEIGHT, with at least 80 transparent pixels between neighbouring silhouettes. Absolutely NO touching or overlapping sprites. NO shadows, floor, lettering, numbers, border, checkerboard, diagram or particles. True alpha background.
Subject: Darya, the brown-haired girl in dark navy tee and charcoal trousers, with her gray-white kitten Pishi crouching alongside behind her feet in EVERY pose.
Use the SAME gorgeous detailed chibi art and exact character identity in the reference. Eight consecutive frames of a seamless LOW baseball slide/glide loop, ALL FACING RIGHT. First to fourth frames top row, fifth to eighth frames bottom row. Keep all poses LOW throughout. One leg extended forward, the other tucked; torso lies nearly horizontally leaning back toward ground; head is low but clear and fully recognizable with natural facial/body proportions, one hand close to ground. Subtle movement of hair and clothing. Every sprite including wings/kitten and extended toes is completely visible with EMPTY gutters on ALL sides. Keep exactly the same uniform person scale from cell to cell. These will be segmented by alpha connectivity: separation of adjacent sprites is essential.
